name: Nodest – Workflow Automation and MCP
author: Nodest

sections.description:
Automation and MCP for your WordPress site. Connect WooCommerce, forms and memberships to the apps you use every day without code.

Nodest is a no-code automation platform built for WordPress users. This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Nodest platform, allowing you to trigger automations based on WordPress events and execute actions directly on your site.

Nodest – The automation platform built for WordPress users

👉 Official website
👉 Browse all integrations
👉 Read the documentation

Connect WordPress to the tools you use every day

Your WordPress site is the busiest member of your team. It takes the orders, collects the enquiries, signs up the members and publishes the content. And then you take over. That is the gap Nodest fills.

Nodest is a no-code automation platform built specifically for WordPress. It watches for the things that happen on your site – an order, a form entry, a signup, a new post – and then does the follow-up work for you in the apps you already use.

This plugin is what connects your site to Nodest, and it brings the whole builder with it. You create, test, run and monitor your automations inside your WordPress admin, next to the site they belong to.

Why WordPress users choose Nodest

  • It’s WordPress-Native. Nodest is built around WordPress, not bolted onto it. Orders, entries, members, posts and comments arrive with the fields you would expect, and Nodest can write straight back to your site.
  • It never runs on your hosting. Your site sends a small non-blocking signal and gets on with serving the page. All the real work happens on Nodest’s servers, so automations can not slow your site down or time out your checkout.
  • Your AI assistant can drive it. Nodest is also an MCP server. Ask an assistant for what you need in plain language and it runs the same actions your automations use.
  • You can test before you trust it. Every trigger and every action can be tested on its own, with real data from your site, before you switch anything on.
  • It does not break the bank. Start on the free plan with no credit card, and only pay when your automations are doing real work for you. Get started for free

How it works

From install to first automation is a few minutes. Here is the whole path.

Step 1 – Install the plugin

In your WordPress dashboard go to Plugins > Add New, search for Nodest, then click Install Now and Activate.

Step 2 – Connect your website

Open the Nodest menu in your dashboard and click Connect. Sign in, or create your free account, and your site is linked. Nodest uses WordPress Application Passwords, so you never share your WordPress password with anyone.

Step 3 – Connect your other apps

Go to the Integrations tab and connect the tools you want to automate – Notion, Brevo, Mailchimp, Asana, Monday.com, Linear, OpenAI, Google Gemini. Sign in once per app and Nodest handles the rest.

Step 4 – Choose what starts your automation

Pick the trigger: a new WooCommerce order, a Fluent Forms or Gravity Forms submission, a new MemberPress member, a failed payment, a published post. You can narrow it down too, so an automation only runs for one specific form or one specific status.

Step 5 – Add the steps that follow

Add as many steps as the job needs and pick the fields that flow between them. Add a filter so the automation only continues when it should, branch into different paths, or pause for a while before the next step.

Step 6 – Test it, then switch it on

Test the trigger and each action with real data from your site and see exactly what comes back. When it does what you expect, activate it. From then on it runs on its own, and every run is logged.

In a hurry? Open the Templates tab and copy a ready-made automation with a single click.

All features

Visual canvas builder

Build automations on a canvas. Add a trigger, connect the steps that follow, and see the whole flow at a glance. No coding at any point.

Ready-made templates

Browse the template library and copy a complete automation with one click, then adjust it to your site. It is the fastest way to see Nodest working for you.

Multi-step automations

One event can kick off a whole sequence. A new member can be added to your email list, given an onboarding task, logged in Notion and welcomed by email – from a single signup.

Filters, branches and delays

Keep going only when a condition is met, split into different paths for different cases, or wait before the next step – perfect for review requests, follow-ups and reminders.

Dynamic data mapping

Every field from every earlier step is available in a picker, so the customer’s name, email, order total or form answer lands in the right field in the next app. No manual copying, no field names to memorise.

Reusable sub-automations

Built a sequence you need in several places, like your onboarding flow? Save it once and call it from any other automation instead of rebuilding it every time.

Test with real data

This is the feature you will miss everywhere else. Test a trigger and Nodest fetches a real recent event from your site. Test an action and it runs once so you can see the exact response. You find out now, not after a hundred customers have gone through a broken automation.

Dashboard

Successful runs, failed runs, active automations and the actions you have used this cycle – on the first screen, inside your WordPress admin.

Run history

Every run is recorded step by step, with the data that went in and the response that came back. When something fails you can see which step broke and why, instead of guessing.

Cloud

WordPress events are sent to Nodest after the page has already finished loading, as non-blocking requests your site does not wait for. No polling, no extra cron jobs, nothing added to your front end. Your visitors never pay for your automations.

Site Health checks

Nodest adds its own checks to Tools > Site Health, so you can confirm at any time that your connection, outbound requests, HTTPS and Application Passwords are all working as they should.

Let your AI assistant work for you

Nodest is a workflow automation platform and an MCP server in one. That means the same actions your automations use can be handed to an AI assistant.

  • Step 1. Create an MCP server in your workspace and choose which actions an assistant is allowed to use.
  • Step 2. Add that server to any AI assistant that supports MCP and approve the connection once.
  • Step 3. Ask for what you need in plain language: “refund order 1482 and add a note explaining why”, “create a page from these meeting notes”, “find the members whose payment failed this week”.

Your assistant picks the right action and runs it. And because it runs through Nodest, those runs appear in the same History screen in your WordPress admin as everything else, with full detail of what happened – so handing work to an assistant never means losing track of it.

Who gets the most out of Nodest

  • WooCommerce store owners automate the work around every order: customer lists, fulfilment tasks, sales logging, review requests and alerts for the orders that need a human.
  • Membership and subscription sites automate onboarding for new members and get told immediately when a payment fails, so they can save the subscription instead of discovering the churn later.
  • Digital product sellers using Easy Digital Downloads turn each purchase into a customer record, a delivery follow-up and a logged sale.
  • Agencies and freelancers give every client site the same reliable automations, and manage them from inside the admin the client already knows.
  • Lead generation sites turn form entries into tasks and issues the right person actually sees, with a confirmation on its way back to the visitor.
  • Content teams and publishers let AI summarise each new post, and route it to the tools where their newsletter and social content is planned.
  • Small teams without a developer finally connect the tools they use every day, without hiring anyone to wire them together.

WordPress Plugins Nodest supports

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • Fluent Forms
  • Gravity Forms
  • Easy Digital Downloads
  • MemberPress

Apps Nodest supports

  • Notion
  • Brevo
  • Mailchimp
  • ActiveCampaign
  • Asana
  • Monday.com
  • Linear
  • OpenAI
  • Google Gemini

That is over 300 ready-made actions and triggers, and new integrations are added regularly. Missing the tool you use? Ask for it at nodest.com/contact.

Requirements

  • A free Nodest account – unlimited automations and 100 actions per month, no credit card required. Sign up here.
  • WordPress 6.0 or higher, and PHP 7.4 or higher
  • HTTPS, the WordPress REST API and Application Passwords enabled

External Service

This plugin connects your site to the Nodest platform (app.nodest.com and api.nodest.com), where your automations are stored and executed. The connection is required for the plugin to work.

Use of the service is subject to the Nodest Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Nodest is GDPR compliant.

  2. Click Install Now, then Activate
  3. Open the Nodest menu and click Connect to sign in or create your free account
  4. In the Integrations tab, connect WordPress and the other apps you want to automate

sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills to create automations?

No. Everything happens in a visual editor: choose what starts the automation, then add the steps that follow and pick the fields that flow between them. If you can use WordPress, you can use Nodest.

Do I need a Nodest account? Is there a free plan?

Yes, an account is required, and the free plan needs no credit card. It includes unlimited automations and 100 actions per month, which is enough to get several real automations running for your site. See nodest.com/pricing.

How does Nodest compare to platforms like Zapier?

General-purpose platforms treat WordPress as one more app at the end of a very long list. Nodest is built around WordPress: your orders, entries, members, posts and comments are first-class and your automation editor is directly in your WordPress admin.

How does Nodest compare to other WordPress automation plugins?

Most of them run the automations on your own hosting, which means your site carries the load and a slow third-party API can hold up a page request. With Nodest your site only sends a small non-blocking signal; every step runs on Nodest’s servers.

Will this slow down my site?

No. Events are sent after the page has finished loading, as non-blocking requests your site does not wait for, and the automation itself runs on Nodest’s infrastructure. There is no polling and no extra cron work for WordPress events, and nothing is added to your front end.

What happens if an automation fails?

The run is marked as failed in your dashboard and in the History tab. Open it to see every step with the data that went in and the response that came back, so you can find the step that broke instead of guessing.

Can Nodest create and update content on my site?

Yes. Alongside triggers, Nodest can write back to your site: posts, pages, categories, tags, users, comments, plus WooCommerce orders, refunds, order notes, products, stock, coupons, customers and much more.

Can an automation start somewhere other than WordPress?

Yes. Nodest is built around WordPress but not limited to it. Events in apps like Linear, Notion or Brevo can start an automation too.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce 7.1 and higher is supported.

Can I use Nodest with an AI assistant?

Yes. Nodest doubles as an MCP server, so any AI assistant that supports MCP can run the actions you allow it to. Those runs show up in your History tab like any other run.

Is Nodest a cloud platform or a WordPress plugin?

Both. The platform is cloud-based, which is what keeps automations off your hosting, and this plugin brings your site’s events to it plus the full builder into your WordPress admin.

Does it work with my theme, page builder or caching plugin?

Yes. Nodest works independently of your theme and adds nothing to your site’s front end, so caching is unaffected.

Why are HTTPS and Application Passwords required?

They secure the connection between your site and Nodest. Application Passwords let Nodest act on your site through the REST API without you ever sharing your WordPress password, and HTTPS keeps that traffic encrypted. Tools > Site Health will tell you if either one is missing.

Does it work on multisite?

Nodest connects one WordPress site to one workspace, so on a network you activate the plugin and connect each site individually.

Some of the apps I use are not integrated yet. Can I request one?

Yes, and please do. New integrations are prioritised by demand, so the more requests a tool gets, the sooner it is built. Send yours from nodest.com/contact.

What happens if I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivating leaves your connection intact, and your automations and run history stay in your Nodest workspace. Deleting the plugin removes its settings and WordPress triggers stop firing. You can reconnect at any time.
sections.changelog:
1.4.1

  • Updated the billing screen to start checkout with the selected price
  • Improved REST request handling for requests sent without a JSON body

1.4.0

  • Added Fluent Forms integration with triggers for submissions, entries, payments and subscriptions
  • Added Easy Digital Downloads triggers for published downloads and file downloads
  • Added MemberPress triggers for members, transactions and signups
  • Added MCP runs to the run history
  • Updated node editor terminology from actions to tools
  • Updated the node editor with improved hover states
  • Updated the template library to show more templates per page
  • Updated the billing screen to show products, prices and plan changes
  • Improved connection handling between WordPress and Nodest
  • Improved admin asset loading with build chunks

1.3.2

  • Updated PHP requirement to 7.4
  • Improved WooCommerce compability

1.3.1

  • Updated S3 component to use the correct path
  • Updated billing component to show the current plan

1.3.0

  • Added support for number, integer, email, date, datetime, radio, boolean and checkbox fields
  • Added functionality for sub-automations
  • Added functionality for delay steps
  • Updated variable picker to improve usability

1.2.1

  • Updated tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.2.0

  • Added support for dependent fields in action and trigger configuration forms.

1.1.0

  • Added support for dynamic fields.
  • Added testing functionality for automation nodes.
  • Added support for optional fields.
  • Added textarea field type.
  • Added select field type.
  • Added support for inherited connections.
  • Added Gravity Forms integration.
  • Added webhook filter support.
  • Fixed hook for WooCommerce order placed trigger.
  • Removed unused DrawerClose component.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
